notes: stock transaction types (st_trns_type_st.fmx): block WHERE EFFECT 1,2,5,6,7 / TRNS_TYPE 7,8,9,12,15,40 and ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD FLAG = 1, duplicate code, store required for transfer / receipt types, effect and type locked once documents exist, delete refused with documents or entry lines; last serial panel; button copy type (with its STACLNK lines)

rules.where: EFFECT in (1, 2, 5, 6, 7) and TRNS_TYPE in (7, 8, 9, 12, 15, 40) and app_rules3_st.trns_type_allowed(TRNS_TYPE_CODE) = 1

ST_TRNS_TYPE.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select c.entry_type || ' - ' || max(c.entry_desc) d, c.entry_type r from ac_trn_codes c where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (c.entry_year, c.entry_type) in (select p1.entry_year, p1.entry_type from ac_password_entry p1 where p1.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p1.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE)) group by c.entry_type order by c.entry_type

ST_TRNS_TYPE.REC_TRANSFER_TRNS.lov: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || t.desc_a d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.trns_type = 9 and t.effect = 6 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by t.trns_type_code

ST_TRNS_TYPE.STORE_CODE.lov: select s.store_code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or s.store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by s.store_code

STACLNK.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select a.account_number || ' - ' || a.account_name d, a.account_number r from ac_master a where a.account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or a.account_number in (select m2.account_number from ac_master m2, ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0'))) order by a.account_number

STACLNK.COST_NO.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || c.cost_desc d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers c where c.cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or c.cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers m2, ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') and m2.cost_status = 1)) order by c.cost_code

STACLNK.COST_NO2.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || c.cost_desc d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 c where c.cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or c.cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers2 m2, ac_password_cost2 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') and m2.cost_status = 1)) order by c.cost_code
